title: Add welcome message below the main shop title on the home (hero) section

requirements.text: Update the Home (Hero) section on the homepage to display the provided welcome message directly below the main shop title "Sheikh Mohammad Saad Document Center" and above the existing subtitle/tagline.

quotes:
Please update the home page with this Welcome Message:
Sheikh Mohammad Saad Document Center mein aapka swagat hai! 📄✨
​Hum Bawana mein aapki sabhi online aur sarkari document sambandhi zarurato ko poora karne ke liye pratibaddh hain. Chahe wo naya Aadhaar update ho, PAN card, ya Ayushman card—hum har kaam poori zimmedari aur tezi se karte hain.
​Hamara maksad hai aapka samay bachana aur aapko behtar sevayein dena. Aaj hi hamari services dekhein ya humse sampark karein!
Also, make sure it is placed right below the main shop title.

acceptanceCriteria: On the home page (Hero section), the welcome message appears immediately after the main H1 shop title and before the existing line "Your trusted partner for professional document services in Delhi".
The welcome message text matches the user-provided message exactly (including punctuation, emojis, and line breaks/paragraphs where applicable).
The welcome message is readable and visually consistent with the current design (centered in the hero content block and responsive on mobile and desktop).

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui or any other frontend immutablePaths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
nonGoals: Do not change backend (Motoko) code or add new backend features.
Do not change navigation, services, about, location, or contact content besides inserting the welcome message in the hero section.
